title: Analysis of Quartic Potential Problems Using Fredholm Integral Operators with Airy Functions
summary: Fredholm integral operators that commute with the Hamiltonians of certain quantum mechanical systems with quartic potentials are introduced in closed analytical form. The operators are expressed in terms of the Airy function, and their eigenvalues fall off exponentially. Using these operators we obtain an exact dual description in terms of infinite one-dimensional chains. The systems discussed include the anharmonic quartic oscillator as well as multivariable potentials and higher dimensional systems.
